entry_points.text: Kobject-to-set conversion recovers the owning governor set; energy enrollment forwards the policy device and sharing mask to the performance layer.
Online-idle marking, dead reporting and architecture dead cleanup are present but inert in this configuration.
Idle entry and exit bracket low-level idle with tracing and tracking coordination under disabled interrupts; deepest-state search and device lookup report missing or read per-CPU storage.

exports.text: Frequency attribute macros build static read-only, read-write, write-only and mode-supplied objects, plus global kobject forms; handler names derive from the attribute name.
Thermal gating requires cooling capability; limit helpers clamp max then min preserving order; scaling preserves precision across word sizes; out-of-range frequencies are nudged back.
Governor registration macros generate module init and exit shims that forward to core register and unregister and report status.
Sharing discovery resolves device-tree phandles for a named list and builds a mask of CPUs with identical arguments; one build reports unsupported.
Hotplug registration binds phase and label to bringup and teardown callbacks; bringup runs toward online and teardown toward offline; multi forms add per-instance nodes; nocalls skips present CPUs.
With idle compiled out, selection, entry, driver and device registration report missing, and play-dead performs no power action.
Mask queries report earliest, latest, successor, ordinal and random set positions plus single representative choice, and iterators walk set bits with combined mask forms.
Masks support tested set, fill, combine and count, textual parse and bounded render, singleton lookup, and variable allocation with release.
Global views expose online sets through counts, predicates and iterators with present-marking and all-mask alias; crash default reports zero core-header size.

hazards.text: Efficiency filtering needs policy data and modifier, strips it before dispatch, retries unfiltered when out of bounds, fails marking on unsorted tables, and warns yielding index zero on unknown relations.
Suspend-to-idle entry must not enable interrupts or touch clock events; coupled states need cross-CPU coordination and timer-stop states run without tick support.
Relaxed bit modifiers lack atomicity; spread and distribute helpers do not distribute here; shifts and clears use differing widths risking tail-bit inconsistency.

invariants.text: Policies require init and verify; drivers offer setpolicy or target paths with fast switch and measurement; intermediate stepping needs indexed setter without async; performance hints need fast switch with boost and energy hooks.
Table walks stop at the terminator with index tracking and validity filtering; low search favors at-or-above, high favors at-or-below, and close compares gaps with exact matches winning.
In fallback builds suspend and resume are inert, notifier registration reports success without effect, and the schedutil test reports false.
Processor removal is refused with permission failure and secondary shutdown is a no-op in this configuration.
Driver states order from highest to lowest draw with safe fallback and coverage mask; power wrappers offer retention paths, returning index on success and negative on failure.
Negative-one start means before the first entry with ordinal and span validation; scans use small width while clear and fullness use large width or live count.
Bit search and mask combining delegate to helpers owned outside D12 and are treated as opaque here.

locks.text: Governor attribute sets serialize membership and reference changes with an embedded update mutex.
CPU-set write guard plus idle pause are inert shims in this configuration, always reporting held or successful.

state_machines.text: Policy appearance and removal emit creation and removal events; each frequency switch emits pre-change before and post-change after to bracket instability.
Bringup moves from offline through early preparation, kick, local start, threaded online to active and online; teardown reverses with dying and dead interleaved.

structs.text: Frequency and governor tunables pair a generic attribute with show and store hooks over a policy or shared set for bounded presentation and update.
Driver records name, flags, private data, attributes, boost state and grouped hooks; governor records name, lifecycle and regulation hooks, list linkage, owner and flags.
Table entries hold flags, opaque driver data and kilohertz frequency; ordering is recorded separately and selects the search variant.
Idle accounting tracks entries and residency; states carry latency and flags; devices hold per-CPU choice; drivers hold capacity and mask; governors hold selection hooks.
Masks are fixed bitmaps sized by maximum CPUs; crash tracking holds capacity, used count and trailing address ranges.
Low and high efficiency-biased relations, a performance selector, invalid-entry and terminator markers, and a boost flag are enumerated.
Driver capability, per-policy governor, cooling, initial-check and related bits, governor switching bits, and transition versus policy notifier ids are enumerated.
Hotplug invalid and offline values, idle state capacity, mask size source with global online view, all-clear initializer, and page-sized ELF alignment are enumerated.
